Check project file modification status

Source: R/check.R
check_project_file_status.Rd

Detects project files that have been modified since their latest completed run (the completed run with the latest submitted_at).

Usage

check_project_file_status(
  directory = ".",
  ext = c("mlxtran", "pkx", "smlx"),
  store = default_store()
)

Arguments

directory

Character scalar. Directory path to check for project files.

ext

Character vector. File extensions to consider as project files. Defaults to c("mlxtran", "pkx", "smlx").

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store(). Nothing is written to it.

Value

A data frame with columns:

  • project_file (character): Full path to the project file

  • run_id (character): Latest submitted completed run ID (NA if no completed runs)

  • run_completed_at (POSIXct): When the run was completed (NA if not completed)

  • recorded_timestamp (POSIXct): Project file timestamp at run time

  • recorded_sha256 (character): Project file SHA-256 checksum at run time

  • current_timestamp (POSIXct): Current project file modification time

  • current_sha256 (character): Current project file SHA-256 checksum

  • timestamp_changed (logical): Whether modification time changed since run

  • checksum_changed (logical): Whether file content changed since run

  • file_exists (logical): Whether project file still exists

  • status (character): Summary status
